nodes.name: App.tsx
nodes.summary: Root React component that composes the global provider stack (auth, language, confirm-dialog) around the application router.

nodes.name: ChatInput.tsx
nodes.summary: ForwardRef chat input box for the NOFXi agent chat with Enter-to-send handling, disabled states, and an imperative focus handle exposed to the parent page.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses React forwardRef with a custom imperative handle (ChatInputHandle) so the parent can refocus the input after sends.

nodes.name: MessageRenderer.tsx
nodes.summary: Lightweight markdown-style renderer for agent chat messages, converting inline bold/code/link syntax and block structures (lists, headings, code fences) into React elements.

nodes.name: PositionsPanel.tsx
nodes.summary: Sidebar panel showing the authenticated user's open trading positions per trader, fetched with SWR via the api client, with symbol normalization and P&L color coding.

nodes.name: UserPreferencesPanel.tsx
nodes.summary: Panel that loads and displays the user's stored AI-agent preference records from the backend via httpClient, with loading, error, and manual refresh states.

nodes.name: LoginPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Login page handling credential submission, session-expired toast notices, onboarding mode selection, and post-auth navigation, clearing stale local storage and invalidating cached system config on entry.

nodes.name: App
nodes.summary: Top-level component nesting AuthProvider, LanguageProvider, and ConfirmDialogProvider around AppRoutes.

nodes.name: ChatInput
nodes.summary: ForwardRef chat input with Enter-to-send keyboard handling and an imperative focus handle for the parent chat page.

nodes.name: renderInline
nodes.summary: Parses inline bold, code, and link markdown syntax within a text run and returns React elements.

nodes.name: renderMessageContent
nodes.summary: Converts a full chat message string into block-level React elements (paragraphs, lists, headings, code fences) using renderInline for inline formatting.

nodes.name: PositionsPanel
nodes.summary: Loads traders and their open positions via SWR, normalizes symbols, and renders P&L-colored position rows with a refresh listener.

nodes.name: UserPreferencesPanel
nodes.summary: Fetches and lists the user's stored agent preference entries from the backend, handling loading, error, and refresh states.

nodes.name: LoginPage
nodes.summary: Handles login form state and submission, shows session-expired toasts, clears stale storage, and routes users by onboarding mode after auth.

nodes.name: RegistrationDisabled.tsx
nodes.summary: Simple notice screen displayed when user registration is closed, offering a localized message and a button navigating back to the login page.

nodes.name: ResetPasswordPage.tsx
nodes.summary: Password reset page with current/new password fields, client-side validation, localized error and success feedback, and redirect after a successful reset.

nodes.name: AdvancedChart.tsx
nodes.summary: Heavyweight candlestick charting component (lightweight-charts based) that fetches klines via httpClient, computes and overlays SMA/EMA/Bollinger indicators, and adapts quote/base units per exchange including CME futures.
nodes.languageNotes: At ~1600 lines this single component manages multiple chart series refs, indicator toggles, and exchange-aware unit formatting in one closure.

nodes.name: ChartWithOrdersSimple.tsx
nodes.summary: Diagnostic simplified variant of the orders chart that only fetches and counts klines and orders via httpClient, used to verify API data availability.

nodes.name: ComparisonChart.tsx
nodes.summary: Multi-trader equity comparison chart that batch-loads equity histories via api.getEquityHistoryBatch, aligns them over selectable time periods, and colors each trader's curve consistently.

nodes.name: DeepVoidBackground.tsx
nodes.summary: Decorative full-screen animated background wrapper used behind auth and landing pages, with an option to disable the animation.

nodes.name: ExchangeIcons.tsx
nodes.summary: Exchange logo helpers: an image component with error fallback, a letter-based fallback icon, and getExchangeIcon which maps an exchange type string to the right logo element.

nodes.name: RegistrationDisabled
nodes.summary: Localized notice that registration is closed with a button navigating back to the login page.

nodes.name: ResetPasswordPage
nodes.summary: Password reset form validating old/new password inputs, calling the auth context resetPassword, and redirecting on success.

nodes.name: getBaseUnit
nodes.summary: Derives the localized base-asset unit label for a symbol depending on the exchange class (crypto, forex/metals, or equities).

nodes.name: AdvancedChart
nodes.summary: Main candlestick chart component managing lightweight-charts series, kline fetching, SMA/EMA/Bollinger overlays, timeframe switching, and exchange-aware unit display.

nodes.name: ChartWithOrdersSimple
nodes.summary: Fetches klines and orders for a trader and reports the counts, serving as a data-availability diagnostic.

nodes.name: ComparisonChart
nodes.summary: Batch-loads equity histories for multiple traders, aligns them across a selected time period, and renders one colored comparison curve per trader.

nodes.name: DeepVoidBackground
nodes.summary: Wraps children in the animated deep-void visual background with an optional animation kill switch.

nodes.name: ExchangeImage
nodes.summary: Image element for an exchange logo that swaps to a fallback icon when the asset fails to load.

nodes.name: FallbackIcon
nodes.summary: Letter-badge fallback icon rendered when no exchange logo asset is available.

nodes.name: getExchangeIcon
nodes.summary: Factory mapping an exchange type string (binance, bybit, okx, hyperliquid, ninjatrader, etc.) to the matching logo component.

nodes.name: HeaderBar.tsx
nodes.summary: Top navigation header for the whole app: responsive menu, page navigation via router paths, language switching, beginner/pro user-mode toggle, and login/logout/account controls with framer-motion animations.

nodes.name: HeaderBar
nodes.summary: Default-exported header component handling nav state, mobile menu, account dropdown, user-mode switching (getUserMode/setUserMode), and login-required gating for protected pages.

nodes.name: MetricTooltip.tsx
nodes.summary: Bilingual performance-metric help system: METRIC_DEFINITIONS maps metric keys (total return, Sharpe, drawdown, etc.) to LaTeX formulas and descriptions, rendered as portal tooltips with KaTeX.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses createPortal plus KaTeX to render LaTeX math formulas inside hover tooltips.

nodes.name: FormulaRenderer
nodes.summary: Renders a LaTeX formula string to HTML using katex.renderToString with error fallback.

nodes.name: MetricTooltip
nodes.summary: Portal-based hover tooltip showing a metric's localized name, KaTeX formula, and description, positioned relative to its trigger element.

nodes.name: MetricLabel
nodes.summary: Convenience label combining metric text with a help icon wired to MetricTooltip.

nodes.name: ModelIcons.tsx
nodes.summary: Icon utilities mapping AI model/provider identifiers (DeepSeek, Claude, GPT, etc.) to brand icons and colors used in model cards and config grids.

nodes.name: getModelIcon
nodes.summary: Returns the brand icon element for a given AI model/provider id at the requested size.

nodes.name: getModelColor
nodes.summary: Returns the brand accent color for a given AI model id.

nodes.name: PunkAvatar.tsx
nodes.summary: Deterministic CryptoPunk-style pixel avatar generator: hashes a seed string and picks background/skin/accessory palettes to render a unique SVG-like avatar per trader.
nodes.languageNotes: Purely deterministic generation — the same seed always produces the same avatar, avoiding any server round-trip.

nodes.name: PunkAvatar
nodes.summary: Memoized avatar component deriving all visual traits (background, face, eyes, accessories) from the seed hash.

nodes.name: getTraderAvatar
nodes.summary: Helper returning a PunkAvatar element for a trader id/name seed.

nodes.name: SiteFooter.tsx
nodes.summary: Minimal site footer showing brand info and official external links from the branding constants.

nodes.name: SiteFooter
nodes.summary: Renders footer links and brand text from OFFICIAL_LINKS/BRAND_INFO constants.

nodes.name: WebCryptoEnvironmentCheck.tsx
nodes.summary: Diagnoses whether the browser provides a usable WebCrypto secure context (via lib/crypto's diagnoseWebCryptoEnvironment) and renders a card or compact status indicator, reporting the status to parents via onStatusChange.

nodes.name: WebCryptoEnvironmentCheck
nodes.summary: Runs the WebCrypto environment diagnostic on mount, tracks idle/checking/secure/insecure/unsupported/disabled status, and renders the matching shield UI.

nodes.name: FAQContent.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders all FAQ categories and Q&A items with an IntersectionObserver that reports the currently visible item so the sidebar can highlight it.

nodes.name: FAQContent
nodes.summary: Maps FAQ categories to sections, registers each item element with an IntersectionObserver, and fires onActiveItemChange as the user scrolls.

nodes.name: FAQLayout.tsx
nodes.summary: FAQ page layout composing the search bar, category sidebar, and content pane, with client-side filtering of translated questions/answers by search term.

nodes.name: FAQLayout
nodes.summary: Holds search and active-item state, memoizes filtered faqCategories against the localized text, and wires FAQSearchBar, FAQSidebar, and FAQContent together.

nodes.name: FAQSearchBar.tsx
nodes.summary: Controlled search input used to filter FAQ entries in the FAQ layout.

nodes.name: FAQSearchBar
nodes.summary: Renders the FAQ search text input and propagates value changes to the parent.

nodes.name: AuthContext.tsx
nodes.summary: Authentication context provider: bootstraps JWT token/user state from localStorage after loading system config, clears expired JWTs to avoid a stuck logged-in state, and exposes login/register/logout flows with router redirects.

nodes.name: isJwtExpired
nodes.summary: Decodes the JWT payload (base64url) and compares its exp claim against the current time.

nodes.name: AuthProvider
nodes.summary: Context provider that loads system config, restores or clears the persisted auth session, resets the 401 flag, and provides login/register/logout plus user state to the app tree.

nodes.name: useAuth
nodes.summary: Hook returning the auth context, throwing when used outside AuthProvider.

nodes.name: LanguageContext.tsx
nodes.summary: Language context persisting the selected UI language to localStorage and exposing it through the useLanguage hook.

nodes.name: LanguageProvider
nodes.summary: Provider initializing the language from localStorage and persisting changes via handleSetLanguage.

nodes.name: useLanguage
nodes.summary: Hook returning the language context, throwing when used outside LanguageProvider.

nodes.name: faqData.ts
nodes.summary: Static FAQ catalog: categorized lists of question/answer i18n keys (getting started, installation, configuration, trading, troubleshooting, security, features, contributing) with a lucide icon per category.

nodes.name: strategy-translations.ts
nodes.summary: Strategy Studio translation dictionaries (coin source, grid config, grid risk, risk control, prompt sections, indicators, publish settings, chart tabs) for zh/en/es plus the ts() lookup helper and per-language aggregates.

nodes.name: ts
nodes.summary: Looks up a strategy translation entry for the requested language with fallback to English.

nodes.name: config.ts
nodes.summary: configApi client: CRUD endpoints for AI model and exchange configurations, encrypting sensitive API keys via CryptoService before submission and handling both plaintext and encrypted create paths.

nodes.name: data.ts
nodes.summary: dataApi client: read endpoints for trader status, account, positions, AI decisions, statistics, equity history (single and batch), leaderboard, competition, and position history.

nodes.name: helpers.ts
nodes.summary: Shared API-layer helpers: API_BASE constant, re-exports of httpClient and CryptoService, Bearer auth-header builder, and tolerant JSON response parsing.

nodes.name: getAuthHeaders
nodes.summary: Builds request headers including the Bearer token from localStorage when present.

nodes.name: handleJSONResponse
nodes.summary: Reads a fetch Response body as text, parses JSON tolerantly (empty body allowed), and throws with the server error message on failure.

nodes.name: strategies.ts
nodes.summary: strategyApi client: list/get/create/update/delete plus activate, duplicate, active-strategy, and default-config endpoints for Strategy Studio strategies.

nodes.name: telegram.ts
nodes.summary: telegramApi client: fetch and update the Telegram bot configuration, unbind the bot, and switch the bound AI model.

nodes.name: alert-dialog.tsx
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui-style AlertDialog primitives wrapping Radix UI with project styling: overlay, content, header/footer, title/description, and action/cancel buttons.
nodes.languageNotes: Radix primitives re-styled via forwardRef wrappers and the cn class-merge helper (shadcn/ui pattern).

nodes.name: AlertDialogHeader
nodes.summary: Layout wrapper applying header spacing/typography classes to alert dialog content.

nodes.name: AlertDialogFooter
nodes.summary: Layout wrapper arranging alert dialog action buttons responsively.

nodes.name: input.tsx
nodes.summary: Styled Input component built with React.forwardRef and the cn class-merge helper (shadcn/ui pattern).

nodes.name: select.tsx
nodes.summary: Custom NofxSelect dropdown replacing the native select: fixed-position menu anchored to the trigger, outside-click and scroll-away close handling, styled with cn.

nodes.name: NofxSelect
nodes.summary: Controlled dropdown component computing menu position from the trigger's bounding rect, closing on outside click/scroll, and invoking onChange with the picked option value.

nodes.name: cn.ts
nodes.summary: Tiny className combiner merging clsx conditional classes through tailwind-merge, used by the shadcn-style UI primitives across the frontend.

nodes.name: config.ts
nodes.summary: Memoized fetcher for the /api/config system configuration (initialized flag, beta mode) with promise deduplication and an invalidation helper that broadcasts a window event after first-time setup completes.

nodes.name: getSystemConfig
nodes.summary: Fetches and caches the system config from /api/config, deduplicating concurrent calls by reusing an in-flight promise and returning the cached value on subsequent calls.

nodes.name: notify.tsx
nodes.summary: Notification facade over the sonner toast library exposing a notify object (success/error/info/warning/custom/promise/dismiss) plus a global confirm bridge where ConfirmDialogProvider registers its handler for confirmToast callers.

nodes.name: confirmToast
nodes.summary: Promise-based confirmation prompt that delegates to the globally registered confirm dialog handler, resolving false with a console error if no provider has registered.

nodes.name: main.tsx
nodes.summary: Frontend entry point: mounts the App component into #root under React.StrictMode and BrowserRouter, and installs a dark-themed sonner Toaster with nofx-branded styling.

nodes.name: AgentChatPage.tsx
nodes.summary: NOFXi conversational agent page: streams SSE responses from the /api/agent endpoint with abortable readers, parses plan/step/replan events into structured AgentStep timelines, persists per-user chat history and drafts to localStorage, and renders the chat surface with market ticker, positions, and preference side panels.
nodes.languageNotes: Keeps the SSE reader and AbortController in module-level variables so the stream survives component unmount and can be stopped from anywhere.

nodes.name: stopActiveAgentStream
nodes.summary: Gracefully stops the in-flight agent stream: appends a localized 'stopped' marker to the streaming message, aborts the reader/controller, and clears the store loading flag.

nodes.name: runAgentStream
nodes.summary: Core streaming loop: POSTs the user message to /api/agent, reads the SSE body chunk-by-chunk, dispatches event types (text delta, plan, step, replan, done, error) into store message patches, merges partial text safely, and handles clear-history commands and stream teardown.

nodes.name: parsePlanSteps
nodes.summary: Parses a plan announcement line (supports English and Chinese 'Plan:' prefixes) into an ordered list of pending AgentStep entries split on '->' arrows.

nodes.name: parseStepEvent
nodes.summary: Extracts a step index, label, and detail from a streamed step-event string via regex, falling back to a sequential index when the payload lacks numbering.

nodes.name: markLatestRunningCompleted
nodes.summary: Transitions the most recent running AgentStep to completed (optionally attaching a detail string) when a step-finished event arrives.

nodes.name: AgentChatPage
nodes.summary: Main chat page component: hydrates per-user messages/drafts from storage, migrates legacy keys, wires send/stop actions to the streaming functions, manages the responsive sidebar (market ticker, trader status, positions, preferences panels), and persists chat state on change.

nodes.name: PageNotFound.tsx
nodes.summary: 404 fallback page rendering a not-found message and home link over the DeepVoidBackground visual.

nodes.name: PageNotFound
nodes.summary: Renders the 404 screen with branded background and a link back to the home route.

nodes.name: AppRoutes.tsx
nodes.summary: Central route table for the SPA: declares all page routes with auth gating and login-required overlays, redirects legacy hash URLs to path routes, wraps pages in AppChrome (header bar, footer), resolves trader slugs from the dashboard query string, and drives data loading for the dashboard route.

nodes.name: findTraderBySlug
nodes.summary: Finds a trader in the loaded list whose derived slug matches the ?trader= query parameter, tolerating name/id variants.

nodes.name: LoadingScreen
nodes.summary: Full-screen branded loading indicator shown while auth/system config state resolves.

nodes.name: LegacyHashRedirect
nodes.summary: Redirects legacy hash-based URLs (e.g. #trader, #details) to their current path routes using the LEGACY_HASH_ROUTES map from paths.ts.

nodes.name: AppChrome
nodes.summary: Layout wrapper adding the HeaderBar, optional SiteFooter, main content container with optional animation, and extra content slots around each routed page.

nodes.name: TradersRoute
nodes.summary: Route component for the AI traders listing page, optionally surfacing the beginner onboarding flow based on user mode.

nodes.name: DashboardRoute
nodes.summary: Dashboard route container: loads traders, resolves the selected trader from the URL slug, polls status/account/positions/decisions via the api client with failure tracking, and passes assembled props into TraderDashboardPage.

nodes.name: AppRoutes
nodes.summary: Top-level Routes declaration mapping every ROUTES path to its page component with auth-aware guards, setup redirection for uninitialized systems, and the 404 fallback.

nodes.name: paths.ts
nodes.summary: Single source of truth for frontend routing: ROUTES constants, page-to-path mapping, legacy hash-route redirect table, and helpers to derive the current navigation page from a pathname and build dashboard URLs with a trader slug query.

nodes.name: getCurrentPageForPath
nodes.summary: Maps a location pathname to the logical navigation Page identifier (agent, traders, trader, strategy, faq, login, register) used to highlight the active header tab.

nodes.name: format.ts
nodes.summary: Numeric display formatting for trading UI: adaptive-precision price and quantity formatters that scale decimal places to magnitude (sub-cent altcoins vs large futures prices), plus a signed percent formatter.

nodes.name: formatPrice
nodes.summary: Formats a price with magnitude-adaptive decimal precision so both micro-cap token prices and index futures render with meaningful significant digits.

nodes.name: formatQuantity
nodes.summary: Formats a position quantity with adaptive decimals, trimming noise for large sizes while preserving precision for fractional holdings.

nodes.name: indicators.ts
nodes.summary: Client-side technical indicator math for chart overlays: SMA, EMA, MACD (with signal and histogram), RSI, and Bollinger Bands computed from kline close data.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure functions over close-price arrays; MACD composes calculateEMA with an internal calculateEMAFromValues helper for the signal line.

nodes.name: calculateSMA
nodes.summary: Computes a simple moving average series over the close prices for the given period.

nodes.name: calculateEMA
nodes.summary: Computes an exponential moving average series seeded from the initial SMA using the standard smoothing multiplier.

nodes.name: calculateMACD
nodes.summary: Computes the MACD line from fast/slow EMAs, derives the signal line via EMA over MACD values, and returns the histogram series for chart rendering.

nodes.name: calculateEMAFromValues
nodes.summary: Internal helper applying EMA smoothing to an arbitrary numeric series (used for the MACD signal line rather than raw close prices).

nodes.name: calculateRSI
nodes.summary: Computes the Relative Strength Index using Wilder-style smoothed average gains and losses over the configured period.

nodes.name: calculateBollingerBands
nodes.summary: Computes Bollinger Bands (middle SMA plus upper/lower bands at a configurable standard-deviation multiple) for chart overlays.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-exporting the traders config and traders modal stores as the single import surface for the stores directory.

nodes.name: setup.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest global setup registering jest-dom matchers and installing an in-memory localStorage mock on window that is cleared after every test.

nodes.name: postcss.config.js
nodes.summary: PostCSS pipeline configuration enabling the Tailwind CSS and Autoprefixer plugins for the frontend build.

nodes.name: trading.ts
nodes.summary: Central TypeScript type definitions for the trading frontend: 19 exported interfaces mirroring Go backend JSON shapes, including SystemStatus, AccountInfo, Position, DecisionRecord/DecisionAction, TraderInfo/TraderConfigData, position-history stats (TraderStats, SymbolStats, DirectionStats), and GridRiskInfo. Several interfaces (TraderStats, SymbolStats, DirectionStats) are documented to match Go structs exactly, making this file the API contract between the React dashboard and the Go server.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure declaration file (interfaces only, no runtime code). AccountsResponse distinguishes the NT8 connection's streamed current account from the trader's persisted selected account, encoding the account-binding gate in the type system.

nodes.name: vite-env.d.ts
nodes.summary: One-line ambient declaration file pulling in Vite's client type definitions (import.meta.env, asset module types) for the TypeScript compiler.

nodes.name: tailwind.config.js
nodes.summary: Tailwind CSS theme configuration defining the NOFX cyberpunk design system: nofx-gold/nofx-bg/nofx-accent color palette, Inter and JetBrains Mono font stacks, scanline and grid background images, glitch/shimmer/scan/float keyframe animations, and neon box shadows. Content globs cover index.html and all source files under web/src.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses an inline data-URI SVG for the scanlines background and theme() references inside custom boxShadow values so neon glows track the palette.

nodes.name: invalidateSystemConfig
nodes.summary: Clears the cached system-config promise so the next getSystemConfig call refetches from the API.

nodes.name: formatPercent
nodes.summary: Formats a numeric value as a fixed-decimal percent string, guarding undefined/null inputs.

nodes.name: cn
nodes.summary: Merges conditional class names via clsx and resolves Tailwind conflicts with tailwind-merge.
